About The College
Jonai is the easternmost sub-division of Dhemaji District in the state of Assam and is about 554
                        kilometers away from the state capital Dispur (Guwahati) and 100 kilometers away from the
                        District head quarter of Dhemaji. Covering a total geographical area of 1111.81 Sq. Km, and its
                        population is 1, 43,199.It is bounded by Arunachal Pradesh in the North, Lali (Brahmaputra)
                        River in the South, Sipiya River & Sadiya Subdivision of Tinisukia district in the East and
                        Simen River in the West. The sub-divisional head quarter Jonai is located between Arunachal
                        Pradesh and river Lali known as Brahmaputra in the North-East part of Assam at 95.160 E
                        longitudes and 27.770 N. latitude.
                        Education is an unending and ongoing life long process. It begins when one enters the stage of
                        life until he/she has his/her exit. Formal education is given by educational institutions.

DR. RAJESWAR PEGU
From The Principal's Desk
Jonai Science College is one of the prestigious colleges in Dhemaji District having both Science and Arts stream. Now with 56 nos. of dedicated teachers and 14 numbers of office staff and 1600 numbers of students in both stream. The college has 16 Departments (HS and TDC level) in the Conventional Courses Under Assam Higher Secondary Education Council and Dibrugarh University.
"Education is not preparation of life, education is life itself. "- John Dewey
The role of an institution/college is not only to pursue academic excellence through a prescribe curriculum activities but also to motivate its students to be lifelong learners and critical thinkers of an ever changing global society.
The educational needs of today are very different from those of the past because of growing competition and with the progress of science and technology. The students must be equipped with the skills required to face the challenges of future. They can do it easily if we can make the surrounding stimulating and purposeful.
Institution must be to instill in the students genuine human and spiritual values, a genuine concern for the welfare of others and commitment to truth and justice and all round development of one's personality to meet situations in life.
Dear Teachers
We believed that, Teachers are the Architect of the nation. They teach and prepare the manpower of the next generation to build up a healthy community. The teachers role in an institution is creating a good environment and building better relationships.
Dear Students Friend and Parents
We foster a positive spirit and believe in partnership between students, parents, teachers and support staff striving to create a good environment that sustains excellence. Our distinction lies in the pursuit of high academic attainment through support, encouragement, praise and motivation.
Our mission is to inculcate the love of knowledge in our students and, for this; we aim to develop the skills and demeanor of lifelong learning, essential for making responsible global citizens. Jonai Science College is the one of the prestigious college and having three stream Arts, Science and Commerce in Jonai civil sub division. This college is a cynosure of all eyes in this region. We have taken up this lofty task with a sense of dedication. Today, the college claims to be a well known centre of higher education.
Wishing you all the best.
